(Fixed graphical corruption, mouse icon ghost trails and game freezing.) 3.Configure ddraw.ini with renderer=gdi and fullscreen=true under [ddraw]. 4.Add "ddraw"="native" under [Software\\Wine\\DllOverrides] in the game's Wine prefix registry. 5.Set Launch to BGMain2.exe directly. | Now works. Gameplay runs at 30 FPS, matching the game's configured frame-rate cap. Videos play at 15 FPS. Previous graphical corruption, ghost trails and gameplay freezing were resolved using cnc-ddraw with the GDI renderer and native DLL override. Saving & loading works. A game that crashes, doesn't start or isn't playable: open an [issue](https://github.com/bornaradusin/PC5/issues/new/choose) with its log (PC5's **Report on GitHub** writes one for you). The game shows as being looked at while the issue is open (or as a fix out, needing testing, once a PC5 that should fix it is out), then as working perfectly once the issue is closed as completed, or as unresolved (it doesn't run) once it is closed as not planned. A copy of a game that needs its store's app running (Steam, the Xbox app or another), which PC5 can't do, shows as such: another copy of it may run. An issue whose reporter doesn't answer for two days is closed, and the game shows as needing testing: it didn't run for them, but another copy or version of it may. Tested it? Reply on the issue, or open a new one with your log. While a game's issue is open, the issue is its row and reports of it wait; once the issue is closed, its state is the game's row until someone reports the game again. A game reported more than once has one row, its newest report's, with the earlier reports named beside it.
